thread.title: Dow's earnings reporters providing a 92-point boost to futures' rally

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Dow's earnings reporters providing a 92-point boost to futures' rally
text:
Published: Oct 16, 2018 9:26 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor
Of the 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +2.17% components, 29 are trading higher in the premarket, with the three that reported third-quarter earnings accounting for nearly a half of the gains in Dow futures YMZ8, +2.20% Of the other reporters, shares of UnitedHealth Group Inc. UNH, +4.73% climbed 3.2%, Goldman Sachs Group Inc. GS, +3.01% rose 2.2% and Johnson & Johnson JNJ, +1.95% gained 0.4%. The stocks' price gains are adding about a combined 92 points to the Dow's price, and futures are up 227 points. The most active Dow stock was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +2.20% which rose 0.9%. The lone Dow decliner Coca-Cola Co.'s stock CVX, +0.49% which lost 0.6%.
